Product Features

  • Compact Size: The total size is 98 x 45 x 40 cm, so it fits in the living room without taking up too much space and is suitable for different types of houses.
  • Flexible Lifting: The table can be raised to a maximum height of 54.5cm. By raising and lowering the tabletop, it can meet the needs of various scenarios, whether it is eating, working, or leisure and entertainment, it is easy to handle.
  • Multiple Storage Options: There are hinged shelves on both sides of the tabletop to store small items, and there are also 4 open shelves at the bottom, convenient for placing decorations or books, so items can be neatly stored in the living room.
  • Smart Lighting: With LED light strips controlled by a mobile app, you can adjust the light color and brightness according to your mood and scene, creating a warm, romantic or cool atmosphere in your living room.
  • Worry-free cleaning: The entire stand design does not have a complex structure because the floor is suspended. This avoids dead corners for cleaning and makes daily cleaning easier and more convenient.
  • High Gloss Texture: The high gloss process is applied to the top and sides of the upper part of the desk top, giving a stylish and bright appearance. Not only does it improve the texture of the coffee table, but it is also easy to clean and stains can be removed by wiping lightly.
  • Reliable material: Made of chipboard, the recommended total load capacity is 50kg. It can carry all kinds of objects stably. It is sturdy and durable, and it does not deform easily even after prolonged use.
  • Convenient Operation: The lifting process is smooth, and the hinged lid storage space is easy to open and close, which makes the use process more convenient and efficient, and improves the life experience.
  • Versatile Style: The simple white appearance, combined with modern design elements, can be easily adapted to a variety of interior styles such as modern, Nordic and light luxury, adding a touch of fashion and sophistication to the living room.

Descriptions

Descriptions

Total dimensions: 98 x 45 x 40 cm large, fold-up coffee table that can be folded up to a height of 54.5 cm. It has a fold-up tabletop, shelves that can be folded on both sides and an open storage area at the bottom. There are four open shelves for decorations or books. The LED light strips, which can be controlled via smartphone app, give the entire living room an atmospheric atmosphere. Thanks to the stand construction, there is no need to clean unused corners. The high-gloss coffee table (the high-gloss position is limited to the tabletop and the four sides of the upper part) is made of chipboard. The recommended total load capacity is 50 kg.
